sqlReaderQuery.value:
@concat(
  'select coalesce(max(loaddate),''1900-01-01'') as last_fetch_date from dbo.load_logs where data_source = ''',
  item().datasource,
  ''' and tablename = ''',
  item().tablename,
  ''''
)
@concat('select *, ''', item().datasource, ''' as datasource from ', item().tablename, ' where modifieddate > ''', activity('lkp_incremental').output.firstRow.last_fetch_date, '''')
